key_terms: Standard form of quadratic equation: ax^2 + bx + c = 0, where a, b, c are real numbers and a is non-zero.
Roots of quadratic equations are identical to the zeroes of the corresponding quadratic polynomials.
Factorisation method: Splitting the linear middle term into two terms to obtain linear factors.
Quadratic Formula: x = (-b +- sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / (2a), derived by completing the square.
